senses.gloss: (v. דְּלָא) to wind, draw water. Denom. דְּוַל, דַּוְולָא.
to wind up, make skeins, prepare for spinning.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 63a:9">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>זבון ולא תדויל</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="D00797"><he>דל</he></cite> 5 buy (ready-made) and do not wind skeins (ed. <he>זבין ולא תיזול</he>, v. <cite ref="G00174"><he>זוּל</he></cite> I a. II).

senses.gloss: to be drawn from, to give water enough for irrigation.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:6">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ודילמא לא מִידְּוִול</he> but perhaps the well (to be dug) will prove unfit for irrigation? <cite ref="Bava Batra 12b">Ib. 12ᵇ</cite>
